name: Gramercy Tavern
dsc: Gramercy Tavern's famous burger is made from a custom blend of dry-aged beef, ground fresh daily and cooked to perfection. This 4-pack includes four premium patties, soft brioche buns, and a special sauce that adds a tangy, creamy finish. Each burger is seasoned simply with salt and pepper, allowing the rich, beefy flavor to shine through. The patties are thick, juicy, and cooked medium-rare for optimal tenderness. This kit is perfect for recreating the iconic New York City dining experience at home.

name: Shake Shack
dsc: Shake Shack's ShackBurger is a modern classic featuring a 100% all-natural Angus beef patty, melted American cheese, crisp lettuce, tomato, and their signature ShackSauce, all served on a soft potato bun. This 8-pack includes eight burger kits with all the fixings. The beef is ground fresh daily and never frozen, ensuring maximum flavor and juiciness. This kit is ideal for family dinners, parties, or any occasion that calls for delicious, crowd-pleasing burgers.

name: Gott's Roadside
dsc: Gott's Roadside Complete Cheeseburger Kit for 4 includes four premium beef patties, American cheese, fresh produce, and their famous garlic aioli. The patties are made from 100% Angus beef and cooked to a perfect medium-well. This kit comes with soft brioche buns and all the toppings needed for a classic roadside burger experience.

name: Emmy Squared
dsc: Emmy Squared's Le Big Matt is a Detroit-style burger that features two thick patties, American cheese, pickles, and a secret sauce, all served on a sesame seed bun. This kit for 6 includes everything needed to make these iconic burgers at home. The patties are made from a custom beef blend that is juicy and flavorful.

name: Shake Shack
dsc: Shake Shack's 16-pack ShackBurger is perfect for large gatherings, parties, and events. This bulk pack includes sixteen burger kits with 100% all-natural Angus beef patties, American cheese, lettuce, tomato, and ShackSauce. The beef is ground fresh daily, and the potato buns are soft and pillowy.

name: Westholme Wagyu
dsc: Westholme Wagyu Burger Patties are made from 100% fullblood Wagyu beef, offering an unparalleled level of marbling, juiciness, and flavor. This 12-pack is perfect for grilling enthusiasts who want to enjoy the luxury of Wagyu in burger form. Each patty is 6 ounces and seasoned simply to let the beef shine.

name: Peter Luger Steak House
dsc: Peter Luger Steak House is a New York institution known for its top-quality meats. This pack includes 18 USDA Prime burgers, each weighing 8 ounces. The beef is ground from prime cuts and is incredibly flavorful and juicy. Perfect for large cookouts and events.

name: Old Homestead Steakhouse
dsc: Old Homestead Steakhouse's Burger Bomb Kit is a massive, indulgent burger experience. This kit includes six 8-ounce patties made from a blend of premium beef cuts, along with cheese, bacon, and all the classic toppings. These burgers are thick, juicy, and packed with flavor.

name: Holeman & Finch
dsc: Holeman & Finch's Double Stack Burger Kit includes eight 3-ounce patties (two per burger) that are smashed and cooked to crispy perfection. This kit comes with soft buns, American cheese, pickles, and their signature sauce. A true Southern classic.

name: Pat LaFrieda Meats
dsc: Pat LaFrieda Meats' Goldbelly Burger Bash Pack includes eight of their famous burger patties, made from a custom blend of brisket, short rib, and chuck. These patties are known for their incredible flavor and are a favorite among burger enthusiasts. Perfect for a backyard BBQ.

name: Raoul's
dsc: Raoul's Burger Au Poivre is a French-inspired burger that features a peppercorn-crusted patty, served with a rich cognac cream sauce. This 4-pack includes four patties, buns, and the ingredients to make the signature sauce. An elegant and delicious burger experience.

name: Flannery Beef
dsc: Flannery Beef's Goldbelly Burger Blend is a 4-pound package of their signature ground beef blend. This blend is made from dry-aged beef and is perfect for making gourmet burgers at home. It's rich, beefy, and incredibly flavorful.

name: Gott's Roadside
dsc: Gott's Roadside Complete Cheeseburger Kit for 8 includes eight premium Angus beef patties, American cheese, fresh produce, and garlic aioli. This larger kit is perfect for bigger parties and gatherings, ensuring everyone gets a delicious, juicy burger.

name: Gramercy Tavern
dsc: This combo pack includes Gramercy Tavern's famous burger patties and their house-made kielbasa sausage. The burger patties are made from dry-aged beef, while the kielbasa is smoked and perfectly spiced. A great variety pack for any cookout.

name: 5-8 Club
dsc: The 5-8 Club's Juicy Lucy is a Minnesota legend. This 4-pack includes four burgers with melted cheese stuffed inside the patty, along with sweet potato puffs. The patties are crispy on the outside and oozing with cheese on the inside.

name: Whitmans
dsc: Whitmans Juicy Lucy Burger Kit is a New York take on the classic Minnesota burger. This 5-pack includes five patties stuffed with American cheese, served with soft buns and all the classic toppings. A must-try for burger lovers.

name: Old Homestead Steakhouse
dsc: Old Homestead Steakhouse's Blue Aged Cheddar Jalapeno Burgers are a bold, flavorful option. Each patty is topped with blue cheese and jalapenos, adding a spicy kick to the juicy beef. This 6-pack is perfect for those who love a little heat.

name: Westholme Wagyu
dsc: Westholme Wagyu 6-pack patties offer a smaller quantity of their premium fullblood Wagyu beef. Each patty is 6 ounces and features incredible marbling for a juicy, flavorful burger. Perfect for a gourmet dinner at home.

name: Holy Grail Steak Co.
dsc: Holy Grail Steak Co.'s American Wagyu Burger Party Pack includes 16 premium Wagyu patties, along with buns and cheese. These burgers are rich, buttery, and perfect for a large gathering or backyard party.

name: 4505 Burgers & BBQ
dsc: 4505 Burgers & BBQ's Best Damn Cheeseburger Kit includes 8 patties made from a custom beef blend, along with American cheese, soft buns, and a special sauce. These burgers are juicy, flavorful, and sure to be a hit at any cookout.

name: HALL by Odo
dsc: HALL by Odo's Foie Gras Teriyaki Burger is a luxurious creation featuring a Wagyu beef patty topped with seared foie gras and a sweet teriyaki glaze. This 8-pack is perfect for those who want to elevate their burger game.

name: Hell's Kitchen
dsc: Hell's Kitchen's Juicy Lucifer Burger is a spicy twist on the classic Juicy Lucy. This 4-pack features patties stuffed with pepper jack cheese and jalapenos, served with a spicy aioli. For those who enjoy a little heat in their burger.

name: Cochon Butcher
dsc: Cochon Butcher's Le Pig Mac is a New Orleans-style burger made with a blend of pork and beef. This 4-pack includes four patties, special sauce, and all the fixings. A unique and delicious burger experience.

name: 5-8 Club
dsc: This 4-pack from the 5-8 Club allows you to choose your own Juicy Lucy variations. Options include classic cheese, pepper jack, and jalapeno. Each burger is stuffed with melted cheese and served with sweet potato puffs.

name: Wellingtons LA
dsc: Wellingtons LA's 'The Cheeseburger' Wellington is a creative twist on the classic burger. Ground beef is wrapped in puff pastry with cheese, baked until golden and flaky. This 2-pack is a unique and delicious appetizer or main course.

name: Master Purveyors
dsc: Master Purveyors' Dry-Aged Blend Burgers are made from a mix of dry-aged beef cuts, resulting in a rich, beefy flavor that is unmatched. These patties are perfect for grilling and are a favorite among burger connoisseurs.

name: Holeman & Finch
dsc: Holeman & Finch's Double Stack Burger Kit for 2 is a smaller version of their popular kit. Includes four 3-ounce patties, buns, cheese, pickles, and sauce. Perfect for a date night or a small dinner.

name: Pat LaFrieda Meats
dsc: Pat LaFrieda Meats' Gold Label Burger features 4 patties, each weighing 6 ounces, made from a proprietary blend of the finest beef cuts. These burgers are rich, juicy, and represent the pinnacle of gourmet burger quality.

name: Texas Inn
dsc: Texas Inn's Legendary Cheesy Western Burger is a Southern favorite, featuring a patty topped with cheese, onions, and a special sauce. This 4-pack is perfect for recreating the classic diner experience at home.

name: HALL by Odo
dsc: This combo pack from HALL by Odo includes both Foie Gras Teriyaki burgers and Signature Wagyu burgers. Perfect for those who want to try both luxurious offerings. An 8-pack that is ideal for a gourmet dinner party.

name: Keens Steakhouse
dsc: Keens Steakhouse Burger Kit includes four premium patties made from a custom blend of beef cuts, along with buns and classic toppings. This kit brings the taste of a historic New York steakhouse to your backyard grill.

name: Lone Mountain Wagyu
dsc: Lone Mountain Wagyu offers 100% Fullblood Wagyu ground beef, perfect for making the most luxurious burgers. This 1-pound pack is incredibly marbled and delivers a rich, buttery flavor that is unmatched by regular beef.

name: Wellingtons LA
dsc: This 4-pack of Wellingtons LA's Cheeseburger Wellington features four individually wrapped pastry-wrapped burgers. Each is filled with seasoned ground beef and melted cheese, baked to a golden, flaky perfection.

name: Davila's BBQ
dsc: Davila's BBQ Mesquite Smoked Brisket Burger Patties are infused with the rich flavor of mesquite smoke. This pack includes patties and a dry rub that adds a smoky, spicy kick. A Texas favorite for BBQ lovers.

name: Gott's Roadside
dsc: Gott's Roadside Impossible Burger Kit for 8 includes eight plant-based patties that taste remarkably like beef. These patties are made with Impossible Foods' innovative recipe and are perfect for vegans, vegetarians, and flexitarians.

name: Pat LaFrieda Meats
dsc: This sampler pack from Pat LaFrieda Meats includes both premium steaks and gourmet burger patties. Featuring a selection of their best-selling beef cuts, this pack is perfect for those who want to enjoy the best of both worlds.

name: HALL by Odo
dsc: HALL by Odo's Signature Wagyu Burger is made from premium Wagyu beef and features a rich, buttery flavor. This 8-pack is perfect for a gourmet burger night, offering a luxurious dining experience at home.

name: Alewel's Country Meats
dsc: Alewel's Country Meats Gourmet Burger Box includes 12 premium patties made from a blend of beef cuts. These burgers are perfect for grilling and are a great option for large gatherings, cookouts, and family meals.

name: HALL by Odo
dsc: This 4-pack of HALL by Odo's Foie Gras Teriyaki burgers features Wagyu patties topped with seared foie gras and a sweet teriyaki glaze. A gourmet option for those who want to impress their guests with a luxurious burger.

name: HALL by Odo
dsc: HALL by Odo's Signature Wagyu Burger 4-pack offers a smaller quantity of their premium Wagyu burgers. Each patty is made from 100% Wagyu beef and is incredibly tender and flavorful. Ideal for an intimate dinner.

name: Rocker Bros. Meat & Provisions
dsc: Rocker Bros. Meat & Provisions Burger Patty Assortment includes 12 patties in a variety of blends, including sirloin, chuck, and brisket. This pack is perfect for those who want to explore different beef flavors and find their favorite.

name: The Impossible Foods Shop
dsc: This Impossible Burger kit from Gott's Roadside includes 4 plant-based patties that mimic the taste and texture of beef. Served with buns, cheese, and all the toppings, this kit is perfect for a vegan or vegetarian cookout.

name: Master Purveyors
dsc: Master Purveyors' Short Rib Blend Burgers are made from a rich, flavorful mix of beef short rib and chuck. These patties are incredibly juicy and have a deep, beefy flavor that is perfect for gourmet burgers.

name: Big Shake's Hot Chicken
dsc: Big Shake's Classic Shrimp Burgers are a unique alternative to beef burgers. Made from fresh, chopped shrimp and seasoned with a blend of spices, these patties are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. A seafood lover's delight.

name: Mooby's
dsc: Mooby's Meal Kit includes 6 burgers inspired by the famous movie franchise. Each kit includes patties, buns, cheese, and their signature sauce. A fun and delicious option for fans of the movies and great burgers.

name: 5-8 Club
dsc: This 8-pack from the 5-8 Club allows you to choose your own Juicy Lucy variations. Options include classic cheese, pepper jack, and jalapeno. Each burger is stuffed with melted cheese and served with sweet potato puffs. Perfect for a large party.

name: Davila's BBQ
dsc: This combo pack from Davila's BBQ includes mesquite-smoked brisket burger patties, hot links, and dry rub. The patties are infused with smoky flavor, while the hot links add a spicy kick. A Texas BBQ feast in a box.

name: Sparky's Hatch Green Chile Burgers
dsc: Sparky's Hatch Green Chile Cheeseburger Kit includes 6 patties topped with roasted Hatch green chiles and melted cheese. The green chiles add a mild, smoky heat that perfectly complements the juicy beef. A New Mexico favorite.

name: Shirley Chung's Ms. Chi
dsc: Ms. Chi's Giant Cheese Burger Potstickers are a creative fusion of American and Chinese cuisine. These oversized dumplings are filled with seasoned beef and cheese, pan-fried until crispy. A unique and delicious appetizer.

name: Whitmans
dsc: Whitmans Juicy Lucy 10-pack is perfect for larger gatherings. Each burger features a patty stuffed with melted American cheese, served with soft buns and all the classic toppings. A New York favorite for any party.

name: Lekka Burger
dsc: Lekka Burger's Vegan Grill Kit for 4 includes four plant-based patties that are flavorful and satisfying. Made from a blend of vegetables and grains, these burgers are perfect for vegans and vegetarians who want a delicious grilling experience.

name: 5-8 Club
dsc: The 5-8 Club's 8-pack Classic Juicy Lucy includes eight burgers with cheese stuffed inside the patty, along with sweet potato puffs. This larger pack is great for parties and big family dinners.

name: Pat LaFrieda Meats
dsc: Pat LaFrieda Meats' Brisket Burger 8-pack features patties made from premium brisket, ground fresh and seasoned to perfection. These burgers are rich, flavorful, and perfect for a backyard barbecue.

name: Pat LaFrieda Meats
dsc: Pat LaFrieda Meats' Original Blend Burger 8-pack is a classic choice made from a blend of chuck, brisket, and short rib. These patties are juicy, beefy, and perfect for any burger lover.

name: Rocker Bros. Meat & Provisions
dsc: Rocker Bros. Ribeye Burger Patties are made from premium ribeye beef, offering an incredibly rich and flavorful burger experience. This 6-pack is perfect for those who appreciate the finer cuts of meat.

name: Raoul's
dsc: Raoul's Burgers and Steaks Au Poivre Kit includes both their famous burger patties and peppercorn-crusted steaks. This combo pack offers the best of both worlds and is perfect for a gourmet dinner at home.

name: Pat LaFrieda Meats
dsc: Pat LaFrieda Meats' Short Rib Burger 8-pack features patties made from a flavorful blend of short rib and chuck. These burgers are incredibly juicy and have a deep, beefy taste that is perfect for grilling.

name: Gott's Roadside
dsc: Gott's Roadside Impossible Burger Kit for 4 includes four plant-based patties, buns, and all the classic toppings. These patties are made with Impossible Foods' recipe and taste remarkably like beef, making them perfect for anyone looking for a meat-free option.

name: Rotier's Restaurant
dsc: Rotier's Restaurant Famous French Bread Burger + Fries Kit for 4 includes four burgers served on crusty French bread, along with crispy fries. This Nashville classic features a juicy patty with cheese, lettuce, and tomato, all on a fresh baguette.

name: Burgerlords
dsc: Burgerlords Vegan Burger Patties 12-pack are made from a delicious blend of vegetables and plant-based proteins. These patties are perfect for vegans, vegetarians, and anyone looking to enjoy a healthier burger option.
